# Optional: Lancer sprites (Tiny Swords Free Pack)

The Lancer uses sprites from Pixel Frog's **Tiny Swords (Free Pack)**. That pack is free to use in games but may not be
redistributed, so it is not in this repository. Without it, the Lancer falls back to the knight sprite and everything
still works.

To get the real Lancer:

1. Download the free pack from https://pixelfrog-assets.itch.io/tiny-swords
2. Copy these files from `Units/Blue Units/Lancer/` and `Units/Red Units/Lancer/` into `Lancer/Blue/` and `Lancer/Red/` here:
   `Lancer_Idle.png`, `Lancer_Run.png`, `Lancer_Right_Attack.png`, `Lancer_Up_Attack.png`, `Lancer_Down_Attack.png`
3. In Unity, run **Crash Royale > Rebuild Content and Scenes**.
